concerns.text: Tasks T022 and T035 implement Conditional GMM and McNemar's Test, deviating from Spec FR-003 (Decision Tree/GMM) and FR-006 (paired t-tests). While the Plan notes this contradiction, the tasks lack a mechanism to formally update the Spec or explicitly tag this as a 'Plan-override' exception. This creates a silent weakening of the Spec's explicit requirements without a documented constitutional exception or kickback task, violating FR-030 (Single Source of Truth) and the requirement that tasks must not silently relax spec demands.

Task T018 ('Verify clustering coverage: Ensure ≥ 98%...') is marked incomplete `[ ]` and lacks a corresponding implementation step to generate the verification metric. Spec SC-005 and FR-002a require this coverage to be measured and logged. The absence of a task to compute and save this metric means the acceptance criterion for SC-005 is dropped, violating the requirement that every acceptance criterion must survive into a task's verification step.

Task T032b (Generate VLA Proxy Baseline) is marked incomplete `[ ]` and T036 (Calculate trajectory fidelity) is incomplete. Spec SC-001 and Constitution Principle VII require explicit reporting of the fidelity gap. Without a defined task to compute and save this metric (T036) or generate the baseline (T032b), the core evaluation requirements (FR-005, SC-001) are unverified. This is a dropped acceptance criterion and a silent drift from the Spec's requirement to measure fidelity against the VLA proxy.

Task T026 ('Validate inference performance') is marked incomplete `[ ]` and relies on 'textual acceptance criteria' without defining a script to generate the required memory/timing logs. Spec SC-003 requires measuring computational cost against constraints. The lack of an automated verification step means the acceptance criterion is not preserved in the task list, creating a risk of unverified compliance.
